meaning:
ὁρμή, -ῆς, ἡ
[in LXX: Pro.3:25 (שׁוֹא), etc. ;]
1. a violent movement, impulse: Jas.3:4;
2. a hostile movement, onset, assault. Act.14:5.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: When some of both the Gentiles and the Jews, with their rulers, made a violent attempt to mistreat and stone them,
Behold, the ships also, though they are so big and are driven by fierce winds, are yet guided by a very small rudder, wherever the pilot desires.
